"1  REQUEST" / "Operator or peer"
"2  DISCOVER" / "Identity + capabilities"
"3  AUTHORIZE" / "Consent + scope + budget"
"4  EXECUTE" / "Selected member + harness"
"5  VERIFY" / "Actual result + provenance"

Below, two concise exception pathways in distinct warm-color boxes: branch downward from AUTHORIZE to "Permission denied" → "No dispatch"; branch downward from EXECUTE to "Response lost" → "Outcome unknown" → "Inspect evidence; no blind replay". Ensure these arrows do not lead to a success check.
